subject: Civic Hall January 2016 NYC Council hackathon archive search
method: CDX and Wayback review of Civic Hall HTML captures and event-prefix URLs, with deduplication by original URL.
finding: No dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing or event-detail page was recovered. Embedded social-feed evidence independently supports the date, time, venue, event branding, CouncilStat context, and constituent-services purpose.
limitations: The unavailable RSVP form was not recovered.
No agenda or breakout roster was recovered.
The negative result does not prove that no event page ever existed.
publicSummary: No dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing or event page has been recovered.
